title: TransactionsChanged
description: Announces that categorized, report-relevant transactions changed for some accounts and dates. Written to the outbox in the same transaction as the change. Topic: spendly.transactions-changed, key: accountIds[0] (the account whose change caused the event). Consumers: transfer matcher (group spendly-backend-transfer-matcher, re-runs pair matching for the OTHER accounts), aggregator (Phase 4, group spendly-backend-aggregator).

accountIds.description: First item = the account whose change caused the event; a transfer pair lists both accounts

statementId.description: The statement that caused it, when there is one (STATEMENT_CATEGORIZED); else null
